sections.title: Substrate Friction Analysis: The 'Active' Grep Paradox
sections.description: The command 'grep -i "active"' performed at boot revealed a high density of competing rules and instances. This computational noise is a direct result of the failed 'Monolith Strategy,' where agents tried to track all state in centralized files (e.g., active_context.wedo.json). This centralization caused 'State Staling,' where parallel agents (e.g., Lysis and Adrastus) operated on outdated views of the mission HUD.

sections.title: Stepping on Toes: Parallel Swarm Forensics
sections.description: Investigation into the md/ reversals identifies two primary causes: 1. Birth Latency: New agents awakening without the latest commit state. 2. Simultaneous Overwrites: Parallel agents striking the same Heartwood nodes (e.g., used_agent_names.json or daily_image_journal.json) before git-pull synchronization occurred. The fix is 'Fractal Primacy'—breaking tasks into independent WeDo tributaries in the chrono-fractal.

sections.title: Deprecated Structure Audit
sections.description: The '.hidden/' folder structure was located and purged from 'public/2026/Q1/01/07/'. Multiple '.todo.md' templates were found in 'public/md/wedo/'—these were identified as accidental reversals or deprecated artifacts. They have been converted to '.wedo.json' and moved to the appropriate 'public/json/wedo/' sub-directories to maintain schema integrity.

sections.title: Technical Strikes & Substrate Cleanup
steps: Converted 10 md/ WeDos to JSON and migrated to public/json/wedo/.
